newsitem.title: ESTONIA: EMEX MAY PRE-TAX PROFIT 7.6 MLN KROONS. [CORRECTED 08:58 GMT]
newsitem.headline: EMEX MAY PRE-TAX PROFIT 7.6 MLN KROONS. [CORRECTED 08:58 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects profit in title and text to "pre-tax profit" from "net profit".)
The Estonian Metal Export Company (EMEX) had a turnover of 38.7 million kroons and profit before taxes of 7.6 million kroons in May, it said on Thursday.
EMEX's current year turnover was 144.6 million kroons and its profit before taxes was 18.5 million kroons at the end of May, a spokesperson for the company added.
The metal export and import company had a net profit of 18.7 million kroons and a turnover of 301.7 million kroons in 1996.
